ideas.title: Tables with row actions, selection, and tree rows
ideas.pitch: One headless Table primitive behind every Mosaic table: select rows, expand a tree, open a row menu, with sticky columns holding still.
beats: Scroll sideways past a sticky column

ideas.title: Sensitive changes ask you to confirm it's you
ideas.pitch: Changing a primary email, adding a passkey, or connecting an account now steps into reverification inline, then picks up where you left off.
beats: Change lands and the row updates

ideas.title: Select with multiple selection and media options
ideas.pitch: Select now takes avatars and logos in its options and lets you pick more than one.
beats: Open a Select with avatar options

ideas.title: ProviderButton and ProviderButtonGroup
ideas.pitch: Social sign-in buttons as one component: logos bundled, grouped layout handled for you.
beats: Add two more and watch the group reflow

ideas.title: Switch and Radio
ideas.pitch: Two new form controls with Mosaic's motion and states.

ideas.title: Reveal
ideas.pitch: A new Reveal component; check the PR for what it animates before scripting the beats.

ideas.title: Menus that hold open while work starts
ideas.pitch: Sending a code or regenerating backup codes keeps the menu open with a pending row, instead of closing on you and leaving you guessing.
beats: Row shows pending, then the code step opens

ideas.title: Creating an API key keeps the secret on screen until copied
ideas.pitch: The new-key dialog won't close until you've copied the secret, so nobody loses it.

ideas.title: Skeleton rows while tables load
ideas.pitch: Members, API keys, and active devices show skeleton rows on first load instead of an empty jump.

ideas.title: Phone input that formats as you type
ideas.pitch: The caret stays put while the number formats, and the country picker is tighter.

ideas.title: Page, surface, and subtle color tokens
ideas.pitch: New color tokens aligned with Figma, with better secondary text contrast in light mode.
beats: A profile card on the page token
Swap the theme's tokens in the code

ideas.title: The profile reopens after an OAuth redirect
ideas.pitch: Connect a Google account from the profile modal and land back in it, not on a bare page.
beats: Modal is open on Connected accounts
ideas.note: Needs a faked redirect on the stage.
